integrity: The face complex is reconstructed from the published \(K_6\) incidence mnemonic; all triangle, rank, cocycle, and symmetry-orbit assertions are exhaustively recomputed from that reconstruction.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns simple edge cycles over \(\mathbf F_2\) in the labeled triangulation \(RP^4_{16}\); it does not classify longer representatives or integral one-cycles. The 1999 dissertation predates the day-specific source used for `first_public_date`, but the inspected evidence did not provide an exact calendar day for that dissertation.
title: Four symmetry orbits exhaust the mod-two one-systoles of the 16-vertex real projective four-space
